maya: Quick sync 10am PT mini-launch next Tue. Need X + LinkedIn threads, assets, and who owns 48h followups. cc @lena @tom
lena: I can handle X posting + first-day replies. Need hero 1200x675 + 1:1 clip.
tom: I'll take LinkedIn thread + partner outreach. Is the benchmark copy final?
maya: Draft in Drive: bullets (latency, cost, Acme blurb). Shorten for LI.
cj: Asset list: hero JPG, square PNG, 30s mp4, 15s vertical, CTA overlay, alt text.
kai: Registration link?
social-bot: Registration -> https://redwood.ai/events/miniwave?utm_source=social
lena: X thread plan: teaser -> stat -> CTA. Posts at 10:00 PT, 15:00 PT, next-day 09:00 PT. Pin FAQ with timezone conversions.
tom: LI draft: "Predictable latency. Cost controls. Unified deploys. Join our webinar for benchmarks + live Q&A. Register: [link]"
lena: Suggest adding stat: "2-5x cost reduction in kv-caching workloads"  need legal signoff.
maya: Legal cleared the stat; backup copy without stat ready. CJ, can you render the clip with stat overlay + CTA by Fri EOD?
cj: Yep, will upload to #marketing-assets and Drive.
kai: Who handles product questions in comments? I'll take product Qs on LI, lena handles support replies on X, tom handles partner mentions.
maya: Playbook: 1) collect top 10 replies, 2) route demos to AE, 3) DM top prospects. Also send RSVP reminder 24h before.
lena: I'll pin the FAQ and schedule RSVP DM.
maya: Final checklist: assets, captions (X/LI), UTMs, schedule, owners, playbook. Say now if missing.
tom: Posting LI draft to doc for signoff.
lena: :thumbsup:
maya: Thanks team :rocket:
